notSent.name: The weekly plan-your-week nudge
notSent.why: Recommended against: a digest with content would put the child's foods in an email; a contentless one duplicates the Pack dot and the 6pm reminder; Resend's free plan is 100 a day and Sunday's send would compete with sign-in links. If overruled: opt-in on Account, Sunday 4pm local, subject "Sunday: plan the week", no household content, one button to Week.
